## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly reports that the requested target is not established, but its reasons remain unsupported. No durable inspection record identifies source-30 as non-citable or maps source-29/source-30 to the supplied literature candidates. The external search did run; however, it does not establish inspection of the specified persisted sources.
- claim-2: The conclusion is appropriate relative to the missing evidence, but the strategy does not satisfy the task: it declines inspection rather than supplying exhaustive coverage. The candidate 2011 text contains at least Conjecture 4.10 and Question 5.1 [arxiv:0809.2981v2, lines 938-975] [arxiv:0809.2981v2, lines 1143-1156], but it cannot replace source-30 without a durable identity mapping. Moreover, Conjecture 4.10 depends on the complete parameterized Theorem 4.8 statement [arxiv:0809.2981v2, lines 847-892]; quoting only its short label would be incomplete. Candidate-2 has no citable full-text block and cannot provide itemwise source-29 status evidence.

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] Prove exhaustive coverage by classifying every occurrence of the exact tokens “Conjecture,” “Question,” and “Problem” in canonical source-30, showing that the reported labelled-item list contains every classified label.
- [computation] Execute a byte-stable scan of canonical source-30 and source-29, recording file digests, every matching token with byte and line offsets, and replayable output; include searches in source-29 for each source-30 item’s label, number, and distinctive statement text.
- [source-refresh] Supply durable bounded source-30 excerpts containing each complete labelled statement and all referenced parameters, plus itemwise bounded source-29 excerpts stating its status—or the executed exhaustive search and inspected contexts establishing that source-29 states no status.

## Required revisions
- Ground the asserted citability condition and exact identities of source-29 and source-30.
- Replace absence-of-evidence assertions with actual persisted-text inspection and exhaustive coverage evidence.
- Report each labelled item separately with complete parameters and its corresponding source-29 status.
- Retain the explicit conclusion: the requested source-refresh certificate is currently **not established**.
